# mistershell_snap_customizations (Data Source)

Reads existing backend-owned configuration without changing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_snap_customizations" "existing" {
  id = var.snap_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Existing numeric ID, stable configuration key, or local.

### Read-Only

- `configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) configuration = { items = [{ tag_id, skip_collection }] }. List order is priority; [] clears all rows. Parent must remain enabled for writes and restore. Masked secrets are returned as null.
